description: Pushes a resistance-training guide to the user's Suunto account via the SuuntoPlus Guide Cloud API: the tool for gym sessions. Per exercise a self-paced prep step (a lap press starts it); with lapGranularity 'perSet' (default) each set is a step ended by a lap press, with a rest step between sets (restMode 'countdown' auto-advances after restSec; 'stopwatch' waits for a lap press); 'perExercise' gives one step per exercise, no between-set rests. Text lines are cut to the watch's 40 characters by shortening the exercise name (weight/plates line capped at 36); lap labels carry the shortened name (compare_workout_to_plan matches by prefix). The guide ends with an extra 'Session complete' step, so a perSet session records 2 x (total sets) + 1 laps (get_workout_laps). Needs SUUNTO_APP_NAME to exactly match the app name registered on apizone.suunto.com. Without guideId a NEW guide is created on every call (list_guides / delete_guide tidy up); with guideId that guide is overwritten. No live push: it appears after the phone's next Suunto app sync. Returns Suunto's response (guide id) plus check { verified, note? }: verified:false means the guide was not found in the guide list after the push; say so instead of reporting success. Queued one at a time. Titles and popups on a real watch are not yet verified. Write operation.

detail.description: Display string for set steps (and prep unless 'plates' is given), with weight and sets, e.g. '60kg 3x10'.

last.description: Optional: last time, e.g. '3x8@60kg' (get_exercise_history suggestion.last). Shown with target in a 'TODAY' popup at prep (36 characters max: shortened, then dropped). Unverified on a real watch.

plates.description: Per-side plates for barbell lifts, e.g. '2x20+1x5/side', shown on prep. Compute it yourself.

restSec.description: Rest between sets in seconds (countdown length; only a label in 'stopwatch' mode).

restTargetHr.description: Optional HR (bpm, 41-200) to recover to: a gauge on this exercise's rests, visual only.

guideId.description: Overwrites this existing guide instead of creating a new one.

lapGranularity.description: 'perSet' (default; a lap per set and rest) or 'perExercise'.

title.description: Session name shown in the Suunto app.
